rule: Level = fixed pipeline (carve rooms, add loops, lakes, autogenerators, machines, bridges, doors). Machines are blueprint rows picked by weighted raffle among those that fit the depth and flags; the interior is a chokepoint-sized room or a grown blob; features are placed in list order with count ranges, personal space and near/far bands; a feature below its minimum rolls the whole machine back. Connectivity validator keeps blocking machines from cutting the level. Reward pacing is a deficit against a depth curve, carried forward on failure. Each level has its own seed drawn at game start, generated on first visit, with stair anchors chained between levels.
keep: blueprint rows with count ranges, minimum-instance rule and personal space
chokepoint-sized room interior and blob interior for area machines
connectivity validator (blocking and must-block flags) before a machine is kept
snapshot and rollback when a feature cannot reach its minimum
alternative feature groups where exactly one member is built
reward pacing as a deficit carried to the next level (target count in zone data)
per-level seed drawn once at start and stored; level generated only on first visit
stair anchors chained between levels and snapped to the nearest valid niche
change: gate candidates capped at 50 in scan order (biased west): take a uniform pick over all candidates
area blob fills ring columns after a shuffle (biased): shuffle the whole ring list
repeat feature with minimum 0 never ends: loader rejects repeat rows with minimum below 1
fixed array of 200 zones with no bound check: sized list or fail past a limit
shared failsafe counter reused in item re-roll loop: separate counter
C table rows need a rebuild: move rows to a JSON table checked against a schema at build
look_test: Print six zones from one blueprint set with six seeds, top-down at 375 px wide, entry marked. Dom picks the two that read as a place with a vault or loop and names the maze. Compare with one hand-made zone. Pass if all six are connected per the report, each reward room meets its minimum count, and picks rebuild identically from stored seeds.
